walkableNote: The chamber's floor, in front of the walls.

entrances.note: In through the gap, at left.

hotspotsNote: EVERY ROCK SURFACE is the whole chamber above the floor: doc 05's 'every rock surface', and doc 54's THE WALLS is the same rock. A LISTEN on it is a tap, placed where the click lands. THE VOID is never a hotspot (doc 54: 'No line here says where the void is').

THE GAP.note: Back through the gap to Room 34's tunnel. Doc 57 writes THE GAP from Room 34's side only, so from here it is a stub (errata 72 F).

obstacles.note: Thad's lamp, set down on the floor: he walks round it, never over it.

lamps.note: Thad's lamp on the floor. It slows to stillness across the score's ninety seconds (invariant 8); otherwise it is only a flame (invariant 9). Errata 365: on the redrawn plate's flame.

defaultVerbsNote: Errata 28b. A bare click on the rock is LOOK, and LOOK is the joke that empties out (errata 70 F).

void.note: Where room-33 operation 3 broke the wall (art/staging/room-33/plate-after): tuning, judged by Tyler's ear (doc 57 F2).

figureLight.note: Errata 109, from the pre-playthrough art audit: Thad is drawn in even light so he can go in every room, and here, where the room around him averages 12.8 (of 255) against his 57, he read as pasted on. Graded to about 38, the room's surround plus 25 -- the margin the lit rooms keep -- under a warm lamp multiply gentle enough to keep his coat blue, as the Nugget's (variant B, Tyler, 2026-11-01). A measurement, not a verdict: Tyler's playthrough decides. Errata 365: the redrawn plate is lighter (mean 26.7 against 14.7); by the same rule, the surround plus 25, about 48: brightness 0.85 (was 0.67). Errata 368: the plate is graded back to the dark it had before the redraw, so his brightness is back to 0.67, what the rule gave for that dark.
